scope: Labelled hypotheses for calendar names without a local source, 16 November – 31 December (first batch under the user decision of 16 November 2026).
decision: User, 16 November 2026: where no local source can be found, a qualified hypothesis (“probably a form of …”, “may come from …”) is acceptable instead of an exact study. As before, no sources are shown in the interface.
method: Open names (no reviewed history, no hypothesis, no reviewed root history) from var/namedays-research/month-status136.json. Each proposal is a form comparison, a comparison with a Latvian common word, a stem comparison (LT two-stem names) or, where nothing fits, a sound-based note. Base-name origins are stated as the usual explanation. Every text ends with an explicit hypothesis sentence and is shown under the Hypothesis label; already documented facts stay below it (keep:true). Names that show a reviewed root history (Daniēla, Dāniela, Daniils, Daņiils, Daņila) were left unchanged.
measurement: Source-type sizing in workspace-root var/namedays-research/measure136-summary.json (Wikidata used for counting only).
